title: Venezuelan Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and comforting noodle soup inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, made with gluten-free noodles and a rich, nostalgic broth.

ingredients.name: Nostalgic spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of cinnamon, cumin, and oregano

instructions: In a large pot, combine water, rice, and Venezuelan noodles. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add vermicelli, salt, black pepper, and nostalgic spices to the pot.
Simmer for an additional 5 minutes, or until the noodles and rice are cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional nostalgic spices if desired.
